dedupe_keys.name: concrete400 concrete crack images masks and annotations

description: Concrete400 contains 379 concrete-surface photographs with binary crack masks, 379 bounding-box annotation files and 1,502 classification patches. University of Transport and Communications researchers prepared it to evaluate automated inspection of urban infrastructure in Vietnam. Images and segmentation masks have a resolution of 512 by 512 pixels. The patches comprise 633 crack examples and 869 examples without cracks. The repository recommends 303 training image-mask pairs and 76 validation pairs. Zenodo provides a ZIP archive and describes text-format bounding boxes under CC BY 4.0, with free public access. Photographs cover varying illumination and surface texture; collection dates and physical pixel size are not established by the inspected metadata. Sparse crack pixels and the small field sample constrain transfer to other structures. The repository reports a 3.07% mean crack-pixel share, while the article gives 3.08%; that discrepancy remains unresolved. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating image-based condition observations for structural digital twins. It complements model-opensees through condition evidence, but it supplies neither structural properties nor a damage-to-capacity relationship.
